text: しんじる　みちを　いけえ！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. しんじる　みち = 'the path you believe in'.

patterns.name: 〜え・〜ろ (command)
patterns.explanation: Changing いく to いけ turns it into a blunt order; the extra え is just a shout. いけえ = 'go!'.
